From e558cca217790286e799a8baacd1610bda31b261 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Toke=20H=C3=B8iland-J=C3=B8rgensen?= <toke@redhat.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Jan 2026 12:47:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] bpf, test_run: Subtract size of xdp_frame from allowed
 metadata size
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8
Content-Transfer-Encoding: 8bit

The xdp_frame structure takes up part of the XDP frame headroom,
limiting the size of the metadata. However, in bpf_test_run, we don't
take this into account, which makes it possible for userspace to supply
a metadata size that is too large (taking up the entire headroom).

If userspace supplies such a large metadata size in live packet mode,
the xdp_update_frame_from_buff() call in xdp_test_run_init_page() call
will fail, after which packet transmission proceeds with an
uninitialised frame structure, leading to the usual Bad Stuff.

The commit in the Fixes tag fixed a related bug where the second check
in xdp_update_frame_from_buff() could fail, but did not add any
additional constraints on the metadata size. Complete the fix by adding
an additional check on the metadata size. Reorder the checks slightly to
make the logic clearer and add a comment.

Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/fa2be179-bad7-4ee3-8668-4903d1853461@hust.edu.cn
Fixes: b6f1f780b393 ("bpf, test_run: Fix packet size check for live packet mode")
Reported-by: Yinhao Hu <dddddd@hust.edu.cn>
Reported-by: Kaiyan Mei <M202472210@hust.edu.cn>
Signed-off-by: Toke Høiland-Jørgensen <toke@redhat.com>
Reviewed-by: Amery Hung <ameryhung@gmail.com>
Link: https://lore.kernel.org/r/20260105114747.1358750-1-toke@redhat.com
Signed-off-by: Alexei Starovoitov <ast@kernel.org>

diff --git a/net/bpf/test_run.c b/net/bpf/test_run.c
index 655efac6f133..e6c0ad204b92 100644
--- a/net/bpf/test_run.c
+++ b/net/bpf/test_run.c
@@ -1294,8 +1294,6 @@ int bpf_prog_test_run_xdp(struct bpf_prog *prog, const union bpf_attr *kattr,
 			batch_size = NAPI_POLL_WEIGHT;
 		else if (batch_size > TEST_XDP_MAX_BATCH)
 			return -E2BIG;
-
-		headroom += sizeof(struct xdp_page_head);
 	} else if (batch_size) {
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
@@ -1308,16 +1306,26 @@ int bpf_prog_test_run_xdp(struct bpf_prog *prog, const union bpf_attr *kattr,
 		/* There can't be user provided data before the meta data */
 		if (ctx->data_meta || ctx->data_end > kattr->test.data_size_in ||
 		    ctx->data > ctx->data_end ||
-		    unlikely(xdp_metalen_invalid(ctx->data)) ||
 		    (do_live && (kattr->test.data_out || kattr->test.ctx_out)))
 			goto free_ctx;
-		/* Meta data is allocated from the headroom */
-		headroom -= ctx->data;
 
 		meta_sz = ctx->data;
+		if (xdp_metalen_invalid(meta_sz) || meta_sz > headroom - sizeof(struct xdp_frame))
+			goto free_ctx;
+
+		/* Meta data is allocated from the headroom */
+		headroom -= meta_sz;
 		linear_sz = ctx->data_end;
 	}
 
+	/* The xdp_page_head structure takes up space in each page, limiting the
+         * size of the packet data; add the extra size to headroom here to make
+         * sure it's accounted in the length checks below, but not in the
+         * metadata size check above.
+         */
+        if (do_live)
+		headroom += sizeof(struct xdp_page_head);
+
 	max_linear_sz = PAGE_SIZE - headroom - tailroom;
 	linear_sz = min_t(u32, linear_sz, max_linear_sz);
 
-- 
2.34.1

## Summary of Modifications

### File: `net/bpf/test_run.c`

#### Modifications made:

1. **Removed early adjustment of `headroom` for live packet mode**  
   The line `headroom += sizeof(struct xdp_page_head);` (previously at line ~1298 in the `do_live` block) was deleted. This addition is now performed later in the function.

2. **Restructured metadata size validation**  
   - The existing `xdp_metalen_invalid(ctx->data)` check was removed from its original location.  
   - A new combined check was added: `if (xdp_metalen_invalid(meta_sz) || meta_sz > headroom - sizeof(struct xdp_frame))`  
     This ensures that the metadata size does not exceed the headroom left after reserving space for the `xdp_frame` structure.
   - The subtraction of metadata from headroom was changed from `headroom -= ctx->data` to `headroom -= meta_sz`, using the already computed variable.

3. **Moved the `xdp_page_head` headroom addition**  
   After the metadata validation block, the code now adds `sizeof(struct xdp_page_head)` to `headroom` only for live packet mode. This ensures the page head structure is accounted for in subsequent length calculations (e.g., `max_linear_sz`) but does **not** affect the metadata size limit checked above.

#### Relationships between changes:
- The order of operations ensures that metadata size is validated **before** the headroom is increased for the `xdp_page_head` overhead. This prevents the page head size from inflating the available headroom that is used to limit metadata, which would allow overly large metadata to pass the check.
- The explicit subtraction of `sizeof(struct xdp_frame)` from the allowed headroom in the metadata check acknowledges that the `xdp_frame` structure occupies part of the headroom. Previously this was not accounted for, allowing userspace to supply a metadata size that consumed the entire headroom, leading to failures in `xdp_update_frame_from_buff()` during live packet transmission.
- Together, these changes close the loophole where an oversized metadata could cause packet processing with an uninitialized frame structure, preventing the described vulnerability.
